title.description: The title at the top of the events page.

description.defaultMessage: Our gatherings at 2255 Pillsbury Road. Everyone is welcome.
description.description: The line under the events page's title, saying what the page lists.

calendar.description: The accessible name of the calendar of events.

previousMonth.description: The accessible name of the button that moves the calendar back a month.

nextMonth.description: The accessible name of the button that moves the calendar forward a month.

today.description: The button that brings the calendar back to the current month and selects today.

day.defaultMessage: {date}, {count, plural, =0 {no events} one {# event} other {# events}}
day.description: The accessible name of a day of the calendar, which is a button that selects it. `date` is the day's date in words, already in the reader's language; `count` is how many events are held on it.

selected.description: The label over the selected day's date, above the list of the events held on that day. The date follows on its own line.

all.description: The link on an event's own page that goes back to the calendar of every event.

none.description: What the events page says when the selected day has no events.
